items.title: CVX Q2 Earnings Beat on Higher Output & Strong Refining Margins
items.summary: Chevron posts a strong Q2 as upstream output climbs, downstream margins improve and free cash flow jumps year over year.

items.title: Core Laboratories Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Core Laboratories (NYSE:CLB) reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $124.6 million, up more than 2% from the prior quarter but down 4% from a year earlier, as stronger completion-product sales partly offset disruptions to its service business from conflicts in the Middle East and Russia-Ukraine. items.title: Expand Energy Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Production
items.summary: EXE beats Q2 earnings estimates as higher production and reduced operating costs offset weaker revenues and lower natural gas prices.

items.title: Capital Market Earnings Crash Out
items.summary: Shares of capital market company MSCI and credit rating agency Equifax both posted double-digit declines in response to lackluster earnings.

items.title: Beetaloo Energy Signs Halliburton MOU for Gas-Powered Data Center Development
items.summary: Beetaloo Energy has signed a memorandum of understanding with Halliburton to support a proposed gas-powered AI data center development in Australia's Northern Territory.

items.title: SLB Growth Outlook Hinges on Offshore, Digital and Production Gains
items.summary: SLB's offshore scale, digital growth and ChampionX production strengthen its long-term growth outlook for 2027, but Middle East risks and net debt cloud the near term.
